17: #include "sched/sched.h"
18: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
19: #include "bk7258_smp.h"
20: 
21: #define BK7258_IPI_SCHED        (1u << 0)
22: #define BK7258_IPI_CALL         (1u << 1)
23: #define BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST    (1u << 2)
24: #define BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT  1024
25: 
26: static atomic_t g_ipi_pending[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
27: static atomic_t g_ipi_kicked[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
28: static atomic_t g_boot_seen[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
29: 
30: static int bk7258_smp_kick(int cpu, uint32_t pending)
31: {
32:   uint32_t data[2] = {BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK, 0};
33:   int expected = 0;
34:   int retry;
35: 
36:   if ((unsigned int)cpu >= CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS || cpu == this_cpu())
37:     {
38:       return -EINVAL;
39:     }
40: 
41:   atomic_or_release(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], pending);
42:   if (!atomic_cmpxchg_acquire(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], &expected, 1))
43:     {
44:       return OK;
45:     }
46: 
47:   UP_DMB();
48:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)
49:     {
50:       int ret = bk7258_mbox_send((uint8_t)(cpu + 1), data);
51: 
52:       if (ret == OK)
53:         {
54:           return OK;
55:         }
56: 
57:       if (ret != -EAGAIN)
58:         {
59:           return ret;
60:         }
61: 
62:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
63:     }
64: 
65:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
66: }
67: 
68: void bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(int irq, void *context, uint32_t command)
69: {
70:   int cpu = this_cpu();
71: 
72:   if (command != BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
73:     {
74:       return;
75:     }
76: 
77:   for (;;)
78:     {
79:       uint32_t pending = atomic_xchg_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
80: 
81:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_CALL) != 0)
82:         {
83:           nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, NULL);
84:         }
85: 
86:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_SCHED) != 0)
87:         {
88:           nxsched_process_delivered(cpu);
89:         }
90: 
91:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST) != 0)
92:         {
93:           atomic_set_release(&g_boot_seen[cpu], 1);
94:         }
95: 
96:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
97:       UP_DMB();
98:       if (atomic_read_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu]) == 0)
99:         {
100:           break;
101:         }
102: 
103:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 1);
104:     }
105: }
106: 
107: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu)
108: {
109:   int ret = bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_SCHED);
110: 
111:   if (ret < 0)
112:     {
113:       PANIC();
114:     }
115: 
116:   return ret;
117: }
118: 
119: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset)
120: {
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   for (; cpuset != 0; cpuset &= ~(1u << cpu))
124:     {
125:       cpu = ffs((int)cpuset) - 1;
126:       if (cpu != this_cpu() && bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_CALL) < 0)
127:         {
128:           PANIC();
129:         }
130:     }
131: }
132: 
133: void bk7258_smp_prepare_boot(void)
134: {
135:   int cpu;
136: 
137:   for (cpu = 0; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
138:     {
139:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
140:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
141:       atomic_set(&g_boot_seen[cpu], 0);
142:     }
143: }
144: 
145: void bk7258_smp_boot_notify(void)
146: {
147:   if (bk7258_smp_kick(0, BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST) < 0)
148:     {
149:       PANIC();
150:     }
151: }
152: 
153: bool bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete(void)
154: {
155:   return atomic_read_acquire(&g_boot_seen[0]) != 0 &&
156:          atomic_read_acquire(&g_boot_seen[1]) != 0;
157: }
158: 
159: int bk7258_smp_boot_ping(int cpu)
160: {
161:   return bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST);
162: }

53:  * Description:
54:  *   This is the common start-up logic for the IDLE task for CPUs 1 through
55:  *   (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).  Having a start-up function such as this for the
56:  *   IDLE is not really an architectural necessity.  It is used only for
57:  *   symmetry with how other threads are started (see nxtask_start() and
58:  *   pthread_start()).
59:  *
60:  * Input Parameters:
61:  *   None.
62:  *
63:  * Returned Value:
64:  *   This function does not return.
65:  *
66:  ****************************************************************************/

68: void nx_idle_trampoline(void)
69: {
70: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION_SWITCH
71:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb = this_task();
72: 
73:   /* Announce that the IDLE task has started */
74: 
75:   sched_note_start(tcb);
76: #endif
77: 
78:   /* wait until cpu0 in idle() */
79: 
80:   while (!OSINIT_IDLELOOP());
81: 
82:   sched_unlock();
83: 
84:   /* Enter the IDLE loop */
85: 
86:   sinfo("CPU%d: Beginning Idle Loop\n", this_cpu());
87: 
88:   for (; ; )
89:     {
90:       /* Perform any processor-specific idle state operations */
91: 
92:       up_idle();
93:     }
94: }

96: /****************************************************************************
97:  * Name: nx_smp_start
98:  *
99:  * Description:
100:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
101:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion
102:  *   of the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal
103:  *   multitasking, the additional CPUs would be started by calling this
104:  *   function.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   None
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:
110:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
111:  *
112:  * Assumption:
113:  *   Runs before the full initialization sequence has completed.  Runs after
114:  *   all OS facilities are set up, but before multi-tasking has been started.
115:  *
116:  ****************************************************************************/
117: 
118: int nx_smp_start(void)
119: {
120:   int ret;
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   /* Flush dcache before start other CPUs. */
124: 
125:   up_flush_dcache_all();
126: 
127:   /* Start all of the other CPUs.  CPU0 is already running. */
128: 
129:   for (cpu = 1; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
130:     {
131:       /* Start the CPU */
132: 
133:       ret = up_cpu_start(cpu);
134:       if (ret < 0)
135:         {
136:           serr("ERROR: Failed to start CPU%d: %d\n", cpu, ret);
137:           return ret;
138:         }
139:     }
140: 
141:   return OK;
142: }

The most likely root cause is **not a BK7258 CPU2 vector or reset-register error**. It is an AP initialization-order deadlock/failure:

1. NuttX calls `arm_serialinit()` while still executing the CPU0 idle thread with scheduler lock count 1.

已定位并修复循环重启问题，重新生成了可烧录固件。

**根因**

CP 的 480 MHz、电源和 CPU1 reset release 均成功。`stage=4` 表示 CP 已启动 CPU1，但未收到 AP 的 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD=0x5`。

AP 原启动顺序存在死锁：

1. `arm_serialinit()` 在 NuttX scheduler 仍锁定、CPU0 idle task 上下文中运行。
2. 它创建 Mailbox worker 后同步等待 worker 就绪。
3. scheduler 尚未解锁，worker 无法运行。
4. 物理 Mailbox 没有完成启动，`nx_smp_start()` 无法使用 channel 2 启动 CPU2。
5. AP 无法进入 `board_late_initialize()`，所以不会发送 `0x5`。
6. CP 3 秒后 timeout、rollback。
7. `cp_main.c` 对错误执行 `BK_ASSERT(false)`，导致整芯片反复重启。

日志中的 Wi-Fi 初始化是 CP 每次重启后的初始化，并不能证明 OpenVela AP 已完成启动。

**修复内容**

- AP early serial 阶段现在只执行：
  - Mailbox 静态状态初始化
  - 物理 MBOX channel 1/channel 2 配置
  - IRQ 注册
  - console 注册
- Mailbox 和 MB-UART worker 延迟到正常 `AppBringUp` 线程启动。
- worker 启动后仍检查 CPU0 affinity。
- Mailbox 两个 worker 使用独立 ready semaphore，避免通知串扰。
- `0x5` 提前到 PWC callback 注册之后、heartbeat/PWC worker 启动之前。
- 最终 `PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD=0x11` 的 PSRAM/SMP/480 MHz commit 条件保持不变。
- CP stage 4 timeout 从 `3000 ms` 放宽为 `10000 ms`。
- AP boot 失败后 CP 保留错误和 rollback 现场，不再执行断言制造循环复位。
- 正式 CP 覆盖副本已同步并通过 `cmp`。
- AP 与 CP 均通过 `-Werror` 构建。
- `git diff --check` 通过。

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 AP_SPINLOCK-backed software hwspinlock.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <assert.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: 
11: #include <nuttx/hwspinlock/hwspinlock.h>
12: 
13: #include "arm_internal.h"
14: 
15: static volatile uint32_t g_bk7258_atomic_gate
16:   __attribute__((section(".bk_spinlock"), aligned(32)));
17: 
18: static bool bk7258_hwspinlock_trylock(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
19: {
20:   uint32_t owner = (uint32_t)up_cpu_index() + 1u;
21:   uint32_t value;
22:   uint32_t status;
23: 
24:   (void)dev;
25:   __asm__ volatile
26:     (
27:       "ldaex %0, [%2]\n"
28:       "cmp %0, #0\n"
29:       "bne 1f\n"
30:       "strex %1, %3, [%2]\n"
31:       "b 2f\n"
32:       "1: clrex\n"
33:       "mov %1, #1\n"
34:       "2:\n"
35:       : "=&r"(value), "=&r"(status)
36:       : "r"(&g_bk7258_atomic_gate), "r"(owner)
37:       : "cc", "memory"
38:     );
39: 
40:   return value == 0 && status == 0;
41: }
42: 
43: static void bk7258_hwspinlock_relax(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
44: {
45:   (void)dev;
46:   __asm__ volatile("wfe" ::: "memory");
47: }
48: 
49: static void bk7258_hwspinlock_unlock(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
50: {
51:   uint32_t owner = (uint32_t)up_cpu_index() + 1u;
52:   uint32_t unlocked = 0;
53: 
54:   (void)dev;
55:   if (g_bk7258_atomic_gate != owner)
56:     {
57:       PANIC();
58:     }
59: 
60:   __asm__ volatile("stl %1, [%0]\n"
61:                    "dsb sy\n"
62:                    "sev\n"
63:                    :
64:                    : "r"(&g_bk7258_atomic_gate), "r"(unlocked)
65:                    : "memory");
66: }
67: 
68: const struct hwspinlock_ops_s g_bk7258_hwspinlock_ops =
69: {
70:   .trylock = bk7258_hwspinlock_trylock,
71:   .relax   = bk7258_hwspinlock_relax,
72:   .unlock  = bk7258_hwspinlock_unlock
73: };
74: 
75: void bk7258_hwspinlock_initialize(void)
76: {
77:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate = 0;
78:   UP_DSB();
79:   __asm__ volatile("sev" ::: "memory");
80: }

input.prompt: Analyze why BK7258 OpenVela AP boot trace reaches primary stage 2 in bk7258_start() but not stage 3. Compare current startup, SAU/MPU/VTOR/data/BSS/vector initialization against BK7258 Armino AP startup and linker maps under /home/mi/vela_competition only. Identify concrete likely faults and minimal fixes with file/line evidence. Do not edit. Thoroughness: very thorough.

output:
<task id="ses_029462b75ffedNBg6UGOd8OVHJ" state="completed">
<task_result>
**Conclusion**

The most likely reason the trace stops at primary stage 2 is the first `modifyreg32()` call made before `.bss` is cleared. That helper uses a `.bss` spinlock. On a warm CPU1/AP reset, the lock can retain the value `1`, causing an unobservable spin exactly after stage 2 and before stage 3.

The second concrete possibility is the explicit MPU guard: if the hardware reports fewer than eight data regions, `bk7258_cpu_private_initialize()` enters an infinite `WFI` loop before writing stage 3. The current source and defconfig assume eight regions, but the repository contains no hardware readback proving that assumption.

The data, BSS, linker load addresses, raw vector contents, and packaged AP binary are internally consistent in the current `cmake_out` build. They are less likely to explain this particular stage transition.

**Stage boundary**

In the active startup source:

- [`__start()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:210) disables interrupts, clears the DTCM CPU-ID word, writes the raw trace entry, sets `MSPLIM`, and branches to `bk7258_start()`.
- [`bk7258_start()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:157) writes primary stage 2 at line 162.
- It then performs CPACR access, `.data` copy, `.bss` clear, runtime-vector copy, hwspinlock initialization, SAU, VTOR, and MPU setup.
- Primary stage 3 is written only after [`bk7258_cpu_private_initialize(true)`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:192) returns, at line 193.
- Therefore a trace of stage 2 rules out `arm_initialize_stack()`, syslog initialization, early serial initialization, and `nx_start()` as the immediate cause.

The generated disassembly confirms this ordering. In the current ELF, stage 3 follows the return from `bk7258_cpu_private_initialize()` at `0x0215033c` to `0x0215033e`; it is not optimized away.

**1. Highest-probability fault: `modifyreg32()` uses uncleared BSS**

Source:

- [`bk7258_start.c:162-171`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:162) writes stage 2, then calls `modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, ...)`.
- The helper implementation is [`arm_modifyreg.c:38`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/common/arm_modifyreg.c:38), where `g_modifyreg_lock` is a static `SP_UNLOCKED` object in `.bss`.
- [`modifyreg32()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/common/arm_modifyreg.c:94) takes that lock before reading or writing CPACR.
- The active map places `g_modifyreg_lock` at `0x2801b440` in `.bss`: [`nuttx.map:12104-12107`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.map:12104).
- `.bss` is not cleared until [`bk7258_start.c:178-181`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:178).

The compiled helper is particularly revealing:

```text
atomic_exchange_4(&g_modifyreg_lock, 1)
if old value == 1:
    retry forever
```

The current ELF disassembly at `0x02159140` shows the lock address is `0x2801b440`, and the retry branch loops back to the exchange instruction.

This is a real startup-order bug for retained SRAM. The Armino equivalent does not use `modifyreg32()` at this point. It directly updates CPACR in [`system_cpu0.c:45-48`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/system_cpu0.c:45).

Why it fits the symptom:

1. Stage 2 is already visible.
2. The next instruction sequence enters `modifyreg32()`.
3. AP SRAM can survive CPU1 reset or lifecycle rollback.
4. A stale lock value of `1` causes a silent loop.
5. No exception vector or fault handler is involved, so the trace remains at stage 2.

Minimal fix:

- Replace the pre-BSS CPACR `modifyreg32()` call with direct CPACR read/modify/write, matching Armino.
- Alternatively, explicitly initialize all synchronization state needed by early helpers before calling any locking helper, but that is less robust because other early helpers may acquire BSS-backed locks later.
- The `modifyreg32()` call inside `bk7258_cpu_private_initialize()` is after `.bss` clear and is not subject to this specific ordering problem.

The smallest source change is therefore at [`bk7258_start.c:168-171`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:168).

**2. Explicit pre-stage-3 infinite loop if MPU has fewer than eight regions**

The source defines eight MPU regions:

1. AP Flash
2. AP RAM
3. AP spinlock
4. CP RAM
5. Mailbox UART RX
6. Mailbox UART TX
7. PSRAM
8. Peripheral window

See [`g_bk7258_mpu_regions[]`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:45).

The startup checks the hardware region count at [`bk7258_start.c:134-138`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:134). If it is below the table count, it executes:

```c
for (;;)
  {
    __asm__ volatile("wfi");
  }
```

at [`bk7258_start.c:138-144`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:138).

Stage 3 is after this loop, so a hardware `MPU_TYPE.DREGION` value of 0 through 7 produces exactly the observed trace.

The active generated configuration fixes:

- `CONFIG_ARM_MPU=y`
- `CONFIG_ARM_MPU_NREGIONS=8`

at [`config.h:41-43`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/include/nuttx/config.h:41).

The porting plan explicitly says that the region count must come from `MPU_TYPE.DREGION` and must not be blindly hard-coded: [`BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md:788`](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md:788) and [`backup/BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN（复件）.md:896-901`](/home/mi/vela_competition/backup/BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN（复件）.md:896).

The Armino AP configuration is more permissive:

- Its `mpu_cfg.c` defines regions through region 9, i.e. ten entries: [`mpu_cfg.c:38-137`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:38).
- Its generic MPU implementation supports up to 16 regions and truncates only at that upper bound: [`mpu.c:20-22`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/arch/cm33/mpu.c:20) and [`mpu.c:80-88`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/arch/cm33/mpu.c:80).
- Armino does not contain this OpenVela-style `< required regions` infinite `WFI` guard.

Minimal fix:

- Read and record `MPU_TYPE.DREGION` on the actual AP core.
- If it is eight or greater, this guard is not the current cause.
- If it is below eight, make optional regions conditional or defer them. The first candidates to remove from the earliest map are the mailbox UART overrides and PSRAM, while retaining Flash, AP RAM, required shared memory, and peripherals.
- At minimum, replace the silent `WFI` with a trace detail containing the actual hardware region count and a visible failure path.

This is the highest-priority runtime check after fixing the BSS-backed lock.

**3. Runtime VTOR is set to a data alias, unlike Armino**

OpenVela copies its runtime vector table to:

```text
VMA: 0x28010800
Size: 0x140
LMA: 0x02198600
```

The active map confirms this at [`nuttx.map:11894-11900`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.map:11894).

The startup then sets VTOR to that address at [`bk7258_start.c:128-130`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:128).

Armino instead places CPU0’s runtime vector table in the instruction/secure alias:

```text
__VECTOR_TABLE_CPU0 = 0x08010000
```

at [`app.map:28377-28385`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/app.map:28377), and sets VTOR to `__VECTOR_TABLE_CPU0` in [`system_cpu0.c:39-43`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/system_cpu0.c:39).

The Armino AP map has:

- Boot/core vector tables in Flash at `0x02150000`, `0x02150200`, and `0x02150400`: [`app.map:8481-8498`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/app.map:8481).
- CPU0 runtime vectors at `0x08010000`: [`app.map:28377-28385`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/app.map:28377).

The OpenVela map uses only the `0x280...` data alias and has no IRAM output section.

This is a TrustZone-M concern because the active image is Secure:

- OpenVela enables `CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_SECURE` and CMSE in [`defconfig:21-24`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh/defconfig:21).
- Armino’s secure image uses the instruction/secure alias for the runtime vector table.
- OpenVela’s VTOR points at the SRAM data alias.

This may not explain the stage-2 stop by itself because interrupts are disabled and merely writing VTOR does not immediately fetch a vector. It can explain a later SecureFault, HardFault, or failure on the first exception after stage 3.

Minimal fix:

- Place the runtime vector table at the secure instruction alias, analogous to Armino’s `.iram`/`.vectors_iram` arrangement.
- Keep its Flash load address and copy it to a VMA around `0x08010800`, aligned to 512 bytes.
- Set VTOR to that secure instruction alias.
- Alternatively, prove by hardware readback that the secure VTOR is allowed to fetch vectors from `0x28010800` on this BK7258 revision before retaining the current arrangement.

The OpenVela vector contents themselves are correct for the current image. [`bk7258_vectors.c:29-52`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_vectors.c:29) defines both the boot vector and the complete runtime vector table, and the map confirms both are 0x140 bytes and 512-byte aligned.

**4. SAU programming matches Armino’s two active regions, but the rest of Secure initialization is incomplete**

OpenVela writes:

- SAU region 0, base 0, limit `0x0fffffe3`
- SAU region 1, base `0x10000000`, limit `0xefffffe1`
- SAU control enable

at [`bk7258_start.c:118-126`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:118).

These values correspond to the active Armino template:

- Region 0 starts at `0x00000000`, ends at `0x0fffffff`, NSC enabled: [`partition_bk7236.h:71-88`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Include/Template/partition_bk7236.h:71).
- Region 1 starts at `0x10000000`, ends at `0xefffffff`, NSC disabled: [`partition_bk7236.h:97-114`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Include/Template/partition_bk7236.h:97).

Therefore the SAU base/limit constants are not the first thing I would change.

However, Armino’s `TZ_SAU_Setup()` also programs:

- SCB sleep and reset security policy
- Non-secure exception priority policy
- Fault target policy
- FPU access for the non-secure state
- NVIC ITNS registers

See [`partition_bk7236.h:280-355`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Include/Template/partition_bk7236.h:280) and [`partition_bk7236.h:1165-1179`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Include/Template/partition_bk7236.h:1165).

OpenVela does not perform those operations. Armino also explicitly enables configurable fault handlers in [`system_cpu0.c:60-73`](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/system_cpu0.c:60), while OpenVela only enables the MPU and SAU.

Minimal fix:

- Reproduce the Armino Secure initialization contract using CMSIS-style definitions or carefully equivalent register writes.
- Enable SecureFault, MemManage, BusFault, and UsageFault before enabling the MPU.
- Do this only after the runtime vector table is in a valid Secure location.
- Do not change the two SAU ranges without confirming the BK7258 IDAU and bootloader security state.

The missing SCB/NVIC policy is more likely to affect exception routing and later interrupts than the exact stage-2-to-stage-3 transition.

**5. Data and BSS initialization are correct for the current OpenVela map**

OpenVela uses:

```c
for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; ...)
for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; ...)
```

at [`bk7258_start.c:173-181`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:173).

The active map proves the ranges:

- `.data`: `0x28010000..0x2801079c`, LMA `0x02197da0`: [`nuttx.map:11785-11889`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.map:11785).
- Runtime vectors: `0x28010800..0x28010940`, LMA `0x02198600`: [`nuttx.map:11894-11900`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.map:11894).
- `.bss`: `0x28010940..0x2802ac60`: [`nuttx.map:11905-11906`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.map:11905) and [`nuttx.map:12367-12368`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.map:12367).

The vector copy range is also present in the linker script:

- `.ram_vectors` has `AT > FLASH`
- `__ram_vectors_load = LOADADDR(.ram_vectors)`

at [`ld.script:92-98`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/scripts/ld.script:92).

The active map has zero-sized PSRAM data/BSS sections, and the linker asserts that these sections remain empty because reset-stage PSRAM copy/clear is not implemented: [`ld.script:224-234`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/scripts/ld.script:224).

Therefore there is no current evidence of:

- An invalid `_eronly` address
- A missing `.data` load image
- A BSS range overlapping CP RAM
- A runtime vector load address outside the binary
- An omitted current PSRAM initialization range

For future configurations, a table-driven copy/zero implementation matching Armino’s `__copy_table` and `__zero_table` would be safer. text:
日志已经准确定位根因：

```text
AP trace=41505452 primary=2 secondary=0
```

含义是：

- `0x41505452`：CPU1 确实执行了当前诊断版 OpenVela 镜像。
- `primary=2`：CPU1 已进入 `bk7258_start()`。
- `secondary=0`：尚未进入 CPU2 启动。
- 故障发生在 CPU1 最早期 C 初始化，和 Mailbox、CPU2、PSRAM、PWC 均无关。
- 旧 detail 值是保留 SRAM 中的旧数据，本次已经在 `__start` 中清零。

**根因**

`bk7258_start()` 原来按以下顺序执行：

```c
bk7258_boottrace_primary(2);
modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, ...);  // 开启 FPU
清零 .bss;
```

问题是 NuttX 的 `modifyreg32()` 并不是简单的寄存器读改写，它会取得一个位于 `.bss` 的全局 spinlock。

secondary_start
  -> private initialization
  -> secondary NVIC initialization
  -> secondary Mailbox initialization
  -> bk7258_secondary_idle entry
```

It did not produce a later marker because there are no markers between stage 5 and the online publication. The failure is in, or immediately after:

```text
arm_initialize_stack()
up_irq_enable()
atomic_set_release(&g_cpu2_online, 1)
bk7258_smp_boot_notify()
```

The strongest concrete defect is that the current code enables CPU2 interrupts before it publishes `g_cpu2_online`.

**Current secondary path**

The exact sequence is [bk7258_cpustart.c:56-65](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_cpustart.c:56):

```c

arm_initialize_stack();
up_irq_enable();
atomic_set_release(&g_cpu2_online, 1);
bk7258_smp_boot_notify();
sched_note_cpu_started(this_task());
nx_idle_trampoline();
```

This is unsafe during secondary bootstrap because `up_irq_enable()` can immediately deliver:

- a stale or pending Mailbox IRQ 79;
- a pending PendSV/SysTick/system exception not cleared by the secondary setup;
- an interrupt whose handler uses the shared NuttX scheduler or the hwspinlock-backed libc atomic implementation before CPU2 has published itself online.

`bk7258_irqinitialize_secondary()` clears external NVIC pending bits and disables SysTick, but it does not clear all system exception pending state. It then enables the CPU2 Mailbox route in [bk7258_mbox0.c:402-412](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mbox0.c:402).

This ordering differs from original Armino. Armino CPU2 starts with interrupts disabled in [startup_cpu2.c:266-272](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu2.c:266). - obtains the per-CPU interrupt stack with `up_get_intstackbase(this_cpu())`;
- computes `stack = stacklim + INTSTACK_SIZE`;
- switches the thread to PSP if necessary;
- installs MSP/MSPLIM for the current CPU.

See [arm_initialstate.c:191-240](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_initialstate.c:191).

- CPU2 uses `atomic_set_release()` at [bk7258_cpustart.c:61](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_cpustart.c:61).

```text
up_irq_save()
  -> acquire AP_SPINLOCK at 0x28000000
  -> store g_cpu2_online
  -> release AP_SPINLOCK
  -> restore interrupt state
```

The corresponding lock implementation sleeps in `wfe` while the gate is occupied: [bk7258_hwspinlock.c:18-47](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_hwspinlock.c:18).

The shared gate is correctly initialized by the primary in [bk7258_start.c:200-203](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:200), and the AP spinlock region is mapped as shared non-cacheable memory in [bk7258_start.c:60-64](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:60). However, using the global hwspinlock for a one-writer/one-reader boot flag creates an avoidable bootstrap dependency:

- CPU1 repeatedly performs `atomic_read_acquire()` in a tight loop.
- CPU2 performs a single `atomic_store_release()`.
- Both operations contend on the same non-fair lock.
- The lock implementation uses `wfe`, and the primary’s tight polling loop does not yield or wait.

The minimal robust boot-only implementation would use a dedicated volatile word with explicit barriers rather than the libc atomic API:

```text
primary:
    g_cpu2_online = 0;
    DMB/DSB;

secondary:
    DMB;
    g_cpu2_online = 1;
    DMB/DSB;

primary:
    read g_cpu2_online;
    acquire barrier after observing 1;
```

The existing release/acquire implementation is semantically valid if it completes, but it is a poor primitive for proving CPU2 online during the earliest SMP handoff.

The smallest source change is to keep interrupts disabled until after the online publication and boot notification:

```c

atomic_set_release(&g_cpu2_online, 1);
bk7258_smp_boot_notify();
up_irq_enable();
sched_note_cpu_started(this_task());
nx_idle_trampoline();
```

This matches the essential Armino behavior: secondary initialization and online publication occur while interrupts are masked, and interrupt delivery begins only after the core has reached a valid scheduler/idle state.

For a more robust fix, combine that ordering change with a lock-free dedicated boot flag. The ordering change is the first fix to make; replacing the atomic backend removes the remaining possibility that CPU1’s tight acquire polling prevents CPU2’s one-time store from acquiring the shared gate.

  destination CPU2 = 2

NuttX CPU1 = physical AP CPU2

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 raw Mailbox SMP IPI.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <assert.h>
8: #include <errno.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <strings.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/atomic.h>
14: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
15: 
16: #include "arm_internal.h"
17: #include "sched/sched.h"
18: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
19: #include "bk7258_smp.h"
20: 
21: #define BK7258_IPI_SCHED        (1u << 0)
22: #define BK7258_IPI_CALL         (1u << 1)
23: #define BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST    (1u << 2)
24: #define BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT  1024
25: 
26: static atomic_t g_ipi_pending[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
27: static atomic_t g_ipi_kicked[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
28: static atomic_t g_boot_seen[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
29: 
30: static int bk7258_smp_kick(int cpu, uint32_t pending)
31: {
32:   uint32_t data[2] = {BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK, 0};
33:   int expected = 0;
34:   int retry;
35: 
36:   if ((unsigned int)cpu >= CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS || cpu == this_cpu())
37:     {
38:       return -EINVAL;
39:     }
40: 
41:   atomic_or_release(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], pending);
42:   if (!atomic_cmpxchg_acquire(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], &expected, 1))
43:     {
44:       return OK;
45:     }
46: 
47:   UP_DMB();
48:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)
49:     {
50:       int ret = bk7258_mbox_send((uint8_t)(cpu + 1), data);
51: 
52:       if (ret == OK)
53:         {
54:           return OK;
55:         }
56: 
57:       if (ret != -EAGAIN)
58:         {
59:           return ret;
60:         }
61: 
62:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
63:     }
64: 
65:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
66: }
67: 
68: void bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(int irq, void *context, uint32_t command)
69: {
70:   int cpu = this_cpu();
71: 
72:   if (command != BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
73:     {
74:       return;
75:     }
76: 
77:   for (;;)
78:     {
79:       uint32_t pending = atomic_xchg_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
80: 
81:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_CALL) != 0)
82:         {
83:           nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, NULL);
84:         }
85: 
86:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_SCHED) != 0)
87:         {
88:           nxsched_process_delivered(cpu);
89:         }
90: 
91:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST) != 0)
92:         {
93:           atomic_set_release(&g_boot_seen[cpu], 1);
94:         }
95: 
96:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
97:       UP_DMB();
98:       if (atomic_read_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu]) == 0)
99:         {
100:           break;
101:         }
102: 
103:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 1);
104:     }
105: }
106: 
107: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu)
108: {
109:   int ret = bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_SCHED);
110: 
111:   if (ret < 0)
112:     {
113:       PANIC();
114:     }
115: 
116:   return ret;
117: }
118: 
119: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset)
120: {
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   for (; cpuset != 0; cpuset &= ~(1u << cpu))
124:     {
125:       cpu = ffs((int)cpuset) - 1;
126:       if (cpu != this_cpu() && bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_CALL) < 0)
127:         {
128:           PANIC();
129:         }
130:     }
131: }
132: 
133: void bk7258_smp_prepare_boot(void)
134: {
135:   int cpu;
136: 
137:   for (cpu = 0; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
138:     {
139:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
140:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
141:       atomic_set(&g_boot_seen[cpu], 0);
142:     }
143: }
144: 
145: void bk7258_smp_boot_notify(void)
146: {
147:   if (bk7258_smp_kick(0, BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST) < 0)
148:     {
149:       PANIC();
150:     }
151: }
152: 
153: bool bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete(void)
154: {
155:   return atomic_read_acquire(&g_boot_seen[0]) != 0 &&
156:          atomic_read_acquire(&g_boot_seen[1]) != 0;
157: }
158: 
159: int bk7258_smp_boot_ping(int cpu)
160: {
161:   return bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST);
162: }

日志已经把问题定位到 SMP bootstrap 握手：

```text
AP trace=41505452 primary=22 secondary=5
```

**含义**

- `primary=22`：CPU1 已配置 CPU2 vector，并成功释放 CPU2 reset。
- `secondary=5`：CPU2 已完成：
  - secondary reset entry
  - SAU/MPU/VTOR
  - NVIC 初始化
  - Mailbox channel 2 初始化
  - 进入 secondary idle
- CPU2 本身的 vector、reset polarity、power 和 private 初始化是正常的。
- CPU1 没有观察到 CPU2 online，因此未推进到 `primary=23`。
- 故障位于 `arm_initialize_stack()` 之后的 online 发布和 bootstrap IPI 握手。

detail：

```text
02150239/00007060/00000000/00000000/00000000
```

前两个值来自 reset release 后的 CPU2 control/run status；CPU2 已实际执行到 secondary stage 5，所以它们不表示 CPU2 未启动。

**与原厂实现的差异**

原厂 Armino CPU2 启动顺序是：

1. 关闭 CPU2 中断。
2. 设置 CPU ID 和 stack limit。
3. 完成 `SystemInitCpu2()`。
4. 进入 secondary scheduler handoff。
5. 发布 core ready。
6. 最后由 scheduler first-task 路径开启中断。

当前 OpenVela 原实现却是：

```c
arm_initialize_stack();
up_irq_enable();
atomic_set_release(&g_cpu2_online, 1);
bk7258_smp_boot_notify();
```

存在两个问题：

- CPU2 在发布 online 前开启全局中断，可能立即处理残留 Mailbox/system exception。
- `g_cpu2_online` 和 boot-test flag 使用 libc atomic，而当前 libc atomic 全部经过同一个 AP hwspinlock。
- CPU1 以 480 MHz 紧密执行 `atomic_read_acquire()`，CPU2 只需要取得一次锁执行 store。
- 这个 hwspinlock 非公平，CPU1 可不断重新取得锁，使 CPU2 永久饥饿。
- 实际日志也支持这一判断：CPU1 没有在 500 ms 后执行自己的 timeout，而是一直卡到 CP 的 10 秒 timeout，说明 CPU1 很可能阻塞在 atomic lock 内，而不是普通轮询。

**修复内容**

Bootstrap 握手已从通用 atomic IPI 状态机中完全分离。

新的 CPU2 顺序：

```text
初始化 interrupt stack
写入 volatile online flag
DMB/DSB
发送专用 raw Mailbox BOOT_NOTIFY
开启 CPU2 全局中断
接收 CPU1 BOOT_PING
进入 NuttX secondary idle
```

具体修改：

- `g_cpu2_online` 改为专用 volatile shared flag 加 barrier。
- boot-test flag 改为 volatile shared flag 加 barrier。
- 新增专用 raw Mailbox 命令：
  - `BOOT_NOTIFY`：CPU2 通知 CPU1。
  - `BOOT_PING`：CPU1 验证 CPU2 IRQ。
- Bootstrap 不再依赖 libc atomic hwspinlock。
- 正常运行期的 scheduler/call IPI 仍保留原 atomic pending 状态机。
- CPU2 在 online 和 notify 完成后才执行 `up_irq_enable()`。
- 移除了 500 ms timeout 内可能永久睡眠的 `wfe`，改为可持续检查 timer 的有界轮询。

新增 secondary 阶段：

```text
5  进入 secondary idle
6  interrupt stack 初始化完成
7  online flag 已发布
8  BOOT_NOTIFY 已发送
9  CPU2 全局中断已开启
```

正常情况下轨迹应继续为：

```text
primary=23  CPU1 已观察到 online，发送 BOOT_PING
primary=24  双向 bootstrap IPI 完成
primary=30  进入 board late bring-up
primary=34  0x5 transport ACK 完成
```

63:

103:       UP_DMB();

50: /****************************************************************************
51:  * Name: nx_idle_trampoline
52:  *
53:  * Description:
54:  *   This is the common start-up logic for the IDLE task for CPUs 1 through
55:  *   (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).  Having a start-up function such as this for the
56:  *   IDLE is not really an architectural necessity.  It is used only for
57:  *   symmetry with how other threads are started (see nxtask_start() and
58:  *   pthread_start()).
59:  *
60:  * Input Parameters:
61:  *   None.
62:  *
63:  * Returned Value:
64:  *   This function does not return.
65:  *
66:  ****************************************************************************/
67: 
68: void nx_idle_trampoline(void)
69: {
70: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION_SWITCH
71:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb = this_task();
72: 
73:   /* Announce that the IDLE task has started */
74: 
75:   sched_note_start(tcb);
76: #endif
77: 
78:   /* wait until cpu0 in idle() */
79: 
80:   while (!OSINIT_IDLELOOP());
81: 
82:   sched_unlock();
83: 
84:   /* Enter the IDLE loop */
85: 
86:   sinfo("CPU%d: Beginning Idle Loop\n", this_cpu());
87: 
88:   for (; ; )
89:     {
90:       /* Perform any processor-specific idle state operations */
91: 
92:       up_idle();
93:     }
94: }
95: 
96: /****************************************************************************
97:  * Name: nx_smp_start
98:  *
99:  * Description:
100:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
101:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion
102:  *   of the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal
103:  *   multitasking, the additional CPUs would be started by calling this
104:  *   function.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   None
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:
110:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
111:  *
112:  * Assumption:
113:  *   Runs before the full initialization sequence has completed.  Runs after
114:  *   all OS facilities are set up, but before multi-tasking has been started.
115:  *
116:  ****************************************************************************/
117: 
118: int nx_smp_start(void)
119: {
120:   int ret;
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   /* Flush dcache before start other CPUs. */
124: 
125:   up_flush_dcache_all();
126: 
127:   /* Start all of the other CPUs.  CPU0 is already running. */
128: 
129:   for (cpu = 1; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
130:     {
131:       /* Start the CPU */
132: 
133:       ret = up_cpu_start(cpu);
134:       if (ret < 0)
135:         {
136:           serr("ERROR: Failed to start CPU%d: %d\n", cpu, ret);
137:           return ret;
138:         }
139:     }
140: 
141:   return OK;
142: }
143: 
144: #endif /* CONFIG_SMP */

49:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
50:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
51: 
52:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
53:     {

60:     }
61:

63:     {
64:       g_stats.write_full++;
65:     }
66: 
67:   if (errors != 0)
68:     {
69:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
70:     }

74:                                 uint32_t length)

82:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
83:     {
84:       g_stats.bad_length++;

88:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
89:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
90:     {

153: {

155: 
156:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;

159: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
160: {
161:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
162:   unsigned int i;
163: 
164:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
165:     {
166:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
167: 
168:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
169:         {
170:           continue;
171:         }
172: 
173:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
174:         {
175:           oldest = desc;
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:   return oldest;

182: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
183: {
184:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
185:   int ret;
186: 
187:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
188:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
189:    */
190: 
191:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
192:     {
193:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
194:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
195:       g_processing_order = 0;
196:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
197:         {
198:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
199:           break;
200:         }
201: 
202:       desc->used = false;
203:     }
204: 
205:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
206:     {
207:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
208:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
209:       g_processing_order = 0;
210:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:         {
212:           break;
213:         }
214: 
215:       desc->used = false;
216:     }
217: }

219: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
220: {
221:   uintptr_t rdata0;
222:   uintptr_t rdata1;
223:   uintptr_t sidreg;
224:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
225: 
226:   (void)irq;
227:   (void)context;
228:   (void)arg;
229: 
230:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
231:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
232:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
233:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
234: 
235:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
236:     {
237:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
238:       uint32_t address;
239:       uint32_t length;
240:       uint8_t source;
241: 
242:       if (cpu == 0)
243:         {
244:           mbox_process_desc();
245:         }
246: 
247:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
248:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
249:         {
250:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
251:           break;
252:         }
253: 
254:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
255:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
256:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
257: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
258:       if (length == 0)
259:         {
260:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
261:             {
262:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
263:             }
264:           else
265:             {
266:               if (cpu == 0)
267:                 {
268:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
269:                 }
270:             }
271: 
272:           continue;
273:         }
274: #endif
275: 
276:       if (cpu != 0)
277:         {
278:           continue;
279:         }
280: 
281:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
282:         {
283:           continue;
284:         }
285: 
286:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
287:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
288:              sizeof(desc->message));
289:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
290:       desc->used = true;
291:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
292:       mbox_process_desc();
293:     }
294: 
295:   if (cpu == 0)
296:     {
297:       mbox_process_desc();
298:     }
299: 
300:   return OK;
301: }

101:  * Description:
102:  *   Check if the timer for the watchdog at the head of list is ready to
103:  *   run. If so, remove the watchdog from the list and execute it.
104:  *   Note: This function should always be called in the interrupt context.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   ticks - current time in ticks
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:

111:  *

114: static inline_function clock_t wd_expiration(clock_t ticks)
115: {
116:   FAR struct wdog_s *wdog;
117:   irqstate_t         flags;
118:   wdentry_t          func;
119:   wdparm_t           arg;
120:   clock_t            ret = CLOCK_MAX;
121: 
122:   flags = enter_critical_section();
123: 
124: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS
125:   /* Increment the nested watchdog timer count to handle cases where wd_start
126:    * is called in the watchdog callback functions.
127:    */
128: 
129:   g_wdtimernested++;
130: #endif
131: 
132:   /* Process the watchdog at the head of the list as well as any
133:    * other watchdogs that became ready to run at this time
134:    */
135: 
136:   while (!list_is_empty(&g_wdactivelist))
137:     {
138:       wdog = list_first_entry(&g_wdactivelist, struct wdog_s, node);
139: 
140:       /* Check if expected time is expired */

142:       if (!clock_compare(wdog->expired, ticks))

103:  * Description:
104:  *   Check if the currently executing task has exceeded its time slice.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   tcb - The TCB of the currently executing task
108:  *   ticks - The number of ticks that have elapsed on the interval timer.
109:  *   noswitches - True: Can't do context switches now.
110:  *
111:  * Returned Value:
112:  *   The number if ticks remaining until the next time slice expires.
113:  *   CLOCK_MAX is returned if there is no time slicing (i.e., the task at
114:  *   the head of the ready-to-run list does not support round robin
115:  *   scheduling).
116:  *
117:  *   The value one may returned under certain circumstances that probably
118:  *   can't happen.  The value one is the minimal timer setup and it means
119:  *   that a context switch is needed now, but cannot be performed because
120:  *   noswitches == true.
121:  *
122:  * Assumptions:
123:  *   - Interrupts are disabled
124:  *   - The task associated with TCB uses the round robin scheduling
125:  *     policy

129: clock_t nxsched_process_roundrobin(FAR struct tcb_s *tcb, clock_t ticks,
130:                                    bool noswitches)
131: {
132:   FAR struct tcb_s *ptcb;  /* Pointer to the next ready-to-run TCB */
133:   clock_t ret;
134:   int decr;
135: 
136:   /* How much can we decrement the timeslice delay?  If 'ticks' is greater
137:    * than the timeslice value, then we ignore any excess amount.
138:    *
139:    * 'ticks' should not be greater than the remaining timeslice.  But that
140:    * event seems to be possible, perhaps in cases where pre-emption has been
141:    * disabled or the noswitches flag is set.  This might cause jitter of a
142:    * few ticks in the slicing because the excess amount is not handled.
143:    */
144: 
145:   DEBUGASSERT(tcb != NULL);
146:   decr = MIN(tcb->timeslice, ticks);
147: 
148:   /* Decrement the timeslice counter */
149: 
150:   tcb->timeslice -= decr;
151: 
152:   /* Did decrementing the timeslice counter cause the timeslice to expire? */
153: 
154:   ret = tcb->timeslice;
155:   if (tcb->timeslice <= 0 && !nxsched_islocked_tcb(tcb))
156:     {
157:       /* We will also suppress context switches if we were called via one
158:        * of the unusual cases handled by nxsched_reassess_timer().  In that
159:        * case, we will return a value of one so that the timer will expire
160:        * as soon as possible and we can perform this action in the normal
161:        * timer expiration context.
162:        *
163:        * This is kind of kludge, but I am not to concerned because I hope
164:        * that the situation is impossible or at least could only occur on
165:        * rare corner-cases.
166:        */
167: 
168:       if (noswitches)
169:         {
170:           ret = 0;
171:         }
172:       else
173:         {
174:           /* Reset the timeslice. */
175: 
176:           tcb->timeslice = MSEC2TICK(CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL);
177:           ret = tcb->timeslice;
178: 
179:           /* We know we are at the head of the ready to run prioritized
180:            * list.  We must be the highest priority task eligible for
181:            * execution.  Check the next task in the ready to run list.  If

34: /* In the normal cases, interrupts are not nest-able and all interrupts run
35:  * at an execution priority between NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN and
36:  * NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MAX (with NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MAX reserved for SVCall).
37:  *
38:  * If, in addition, CONFIG_ARCH_HIPRI_INTERRUPT is defined, then special
39:  * high priority interrupts are supported.  These are not "nested" in the
40:  * normal sense of the word.  These high priority interrupts can interrupt
41:  * normal processing but execute outside of OS (although they can "get back
42:  * into the game" via a PendSV interrupt).
43:  *
44:  * In the normal course of things, interrupts must occasionally be disabled
45:  * using the up_irq_save() inline function to prevent contention in use of
46:  * resources that may be shared between interrupt level and non-interrupt
47:  * level logic.  Now the question arises, if we are using
48:  * CONFIG_ARCH_HIPRI_INTERRUPT=y, do we disable all interrupts except
49:  * SVCall (we cannot disable SVCall interrupts).  Or do we only disable the
50:  * "normal" interrupts?
51:  *
52:  * If we are using the BASEPRI register to disable interrupts, then the
53:  * answer is that we must disable ONLY the "normal interrupts".  That
54:  * is because we cannot disable SVCALL interrupts and we cannot permit
55:  * SVCAll interrupts running at a higher priority than the high priority
56:  * interrupts (otherwise, they will introduce jitter in the high priority
57:  * interrupt response time.)
58:  *
59:  * Hence, if you need to disable the high priority interrupt, you will have
60:  * to disable the interrupt either at the peripheral that generates the
61:  * interrupt or at the NVIC.  Disabling global interrupts via the BASEPRI
62:  * register cannot effect high priority interrupts.
63:  */
64: 
65: /* The high priority interrupt must be highest priority.  This prevents
66:  * SVCALL handling from adding jitter to high priority interrupt response.
67:  * Disabling interrupts will disable all interrupts EXCEPT SVCALL and the
68:  * high priority interrupts.
69:  */

72: #define NVIC_SYSH_HIGH_PRIORITY       (NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT - 2*NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_STEP)
73: #define NVIC_SYSH_DISABLE_PRIORITY    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT

text:
日志已经精确定位根因：

```text
primary=26 secondary=10 detail[2]=0000000f
```

含义：

- `secondary=10`：CPU2 完成启动，并成功处理 CPU1 的 ping、返回 ACK。
- `primary=24`：CPU1 已完成双向 SMP Mailbox 握手。
- `primary=25`：CPU1 准备恢复中断。
- `primary=26`：CPU1 进入恢复后的第一个 IRQ。
- `detail[2]=0x0f`：IRQ 15，即 SysTick。
- 没有推进到 `primary=27`，说明 CPU1 永久停在首个 SysTick handler 内。

**根因**

首个 SysTick 会进入：

```text
systick_interrupt
  -> arch timer callback
  -> nxsched_process_timer
  -> scheduler/watchdog/atomic
```

其中 NuttX 的 spinlock、recursive scheduler lock 和 TCB flags 都依赖 libc atomic。当前 libc atomic 由 BK7258 AP 全局 gate 串行化，而此前 gate 使用：

```asm
LDAEX
STREX
```

原厂 BK7258 spinlock 源码明确说明：

```c
/* bk7236/58 three cores, just two exclusive access monitors */
#if CONFIG_CPU_CNT > 2
#error number of cpu cores greater than 2, does not support SMP
#endif
```

当前实际同时运行：

```text
物理 CPU0  Armino CP
物理 CPU1  OpenVela logical CPU0
物理 CPU2  OpenVela logical CPU1
```

三核都会在共享 SRAM 上产生 exclusive access，而芯片只有两个 SRAM exclusive monitor。AP CPU1/CPU2 的 `LDAEX/STREX` 序列可能因此持续失败，首个 SysTick 在 atomic/scheduler 路径永久等待。

这也解释了此前的现象：

- 基于 atomic flag 的 CPU2 online 握手会卡住。
- 改为 raw Mailbox 后 SMP bootstrap 成功推进到 stage 24。
- 恢复 SysTick 后，一重新进入 NuttX 通用 atomic 路径就再次卡住。

**修复**

AP libc atomic gate 已从 `LDAEX/STREX` 改为双 AP 核 Peterson lock：

```text
interested[0]
interested[1]
turn
owner
```

特性：

- 只协调 OpenVela 的两个逻辑 CPU。
- CP 不参与该锁。
- 只使用普通对齐 SRAM load/store。
- 使用 `DMB/DSB` 保证顺序和可见性。
- 位于 AP 专属的 `AP_SPINLOCK` 区域。
- MPU 属性为 inner-shareable、non-cacheable。
- 不再占用 BK7258 SRAM exclusive monitor。
- NuttX 上层 `atomic_*`、spinlock 和 scheduler API 无需修改。
- `trylock()` 保持 NuttX hwspinlock 的重复轮询语义。
- 等待路径改用 `nop`，避免 `wfe` 无界睡眠。

`.bk_spinlock` 当前大小：

```text
0x28000000..0x2800000f
16 bytes
```

仍远小于 64 KiB 保留区，并且未接近：

```text
boot trace 0x2800ffe0..0x2800ffff
```

正式 BK7258 AP 代码中已经没有 `LDAEX/STREX`。

**最新固件**

完整烧录固件：

```text
/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
```

161d4f6bc8f862283117e8ac377791f53c732ca12511529dd65a623371144530

```

c9b705381907eb33cc3c4722aff71320339c215c35a55bf2d7c35803e02d0914
```

/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin
```

```

验证结果：

- AP `-Werror` 构建通过。
- CP/AP 最终打包通过。
- 三份 AP 输入逐字节一致。
- `.bk_spinlock` 大小和地址正确。
- Linker ASSERT 全部通过。
- AP BK7258 源码无 `LDAEX/STREX`。
- `git diff --check` 通过。

修复有效时，下一次轨迹应至少从：

```text
primary=26
```

推进到：

```text
primary=27  首个 SysTick 已返回
primary=28  up_cpu_start() 返回
primary=30  board late bring-up
primary=31  workers ready
primary=32  mailbox link ready
primary=33  PWC start
primary=34  0x5 transport ACK
```

如果仍停在 `primary=26`，说明首 tick 还有一个不经过 libc atomic gate 的锁点，需要继续细分 `nxsched_process_timer()`；但当前修复已经消除了与日志、原厂限制和此前所有停点一致的底层 exclusive-monitor 问题。

**原厂对照结果**

原厂 FreeRTOS SMP 固定：

```c
#define configTICK_CORE CPU0_CORE_ID
```

启动时：

```c
ucPrimaryCoreNum = configTICK_CORE;
```

SysTick handler 明确区分：

```c
if (xCoreID != ucPrimaryCoreNum)
  {
    xTaskIncrementTickOtherCores();
    return;
  }

/* Only the primary tick core advances global time. */
xTaskIncrementTick();
```

因此原厂架构的关键约束是：

- 只有一个 tick owner。
- tick owner 直接推进内核 tick。
- 不使用通用 timer lower-half 回读当前正在运行的 SysTick。
- 每个 secondary core 的 SysTick 生命周期独立处理。

当前 OpenVela 配置却启用了：

```text
CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
```

原路径为：

```text
SysTick
  -> systick_interrupt()
  -> arch timer timer_callback()
  -> nxsched_process_timer()
  -> wd_timer(clock_systime_ticks())
  -> up_timer_gettick()
  -> current_usec()
  -> TIMER_GETSTATUS()
  -> systick_getstatus()
```

即首个 SysTick handler 内部会再次查询当前正在执行的同一个 SysTick lower-half。这与原厂 tick-owner 直接推进内核 tick 的设计不同，并增加了启动期递归状态、pending 检测和 lower-half 全局状态依赖。

**本轮修复**

已关闭：

```text
CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH
```

BK7258 改为 logical CPU0 专属的直接 SysTick ISR：

```c
static int bk7258_timerisr(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
{
  nxsched_process_timer();
  return OK;
}
```

初始化约束：

```text
logical CPU0 owns SysTick
logical CPU1 keeps private SysTick disabled
480 MHz / 1000 Hz = 480000 cycles per tick
reload = 479999
SysTick priority = 0x80
```

```text
CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2
CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
# CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH is not set
```

最终 map 已确认以下旧符号不再存在：

```text
timer_callback
up_timer_gettick
systick_initialize
```

新的有效路径为：

```text
SysTick
  -> bk7258_timerisr()
  -> nxsched_process_timer()
  -> g_system_ticks
```

这与原厂“单 tick owner 直接推进全局 tick”的架构一致。

**新增诊断**

`detail[3]` 用于细分首个 SysTick：

```text
detail[3]=0  还未进入 bk7258_timerisr
detail[3]=1  已进入，卡在 nxsched_process_timer
detail[3]=2  nxsched_process_timer 已返回

则停点位于真正 timer ISR 之前，重点是：

```text
arm_doirq()
  -> nxsched_suspend_scheduler()

其中 `board_autoled_on()` 会调用 GPIO `modifyreg32()`，后续应优先移除 IRQ 热路径中的 GPIO LED 操作。

nxsched_process_timer()

后续可继续细分 scheduler、watchdog 和 critical section。

说明首 tick 已正常返回，接下来应进入 `primary=30..34`。

103: ## 3. 已确认的长期重启与频率缺陷
104: 
105: ### 3.1 32 位时间乘法溢出导致 heartbeat 永久阻塞
106: 
107: AP heartbeat worker 位于：
108: 
109: ```c
110: for (;;)
111:   {
112:     nxsig_usleep(2000000);
113:     bk7258_mbox_send_message(... IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ...);
114:   }
115: ```
116: 
117: 来源：
118: 
119: - `contest/.../chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:70-82`
120: 
121: 当前最终配置同时满足：
122: 
123: ```text
124: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
125: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
126: # CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64 is not set
127: ```
128: 
129: NuttX generic architecture timer 使用：
130: 
131: ```c
132: static uint64_t current_usec(void)
133: {
134:   ...
135:   return TICK2USEC(timebase) + (status.timeout - status.timeleft);
136: }
137: ```
138: 
139: `timebase` 是 32 位 `clock_t`，`TICK2USEC` 为：
140: 
141: ```c
142: #define TICK2USEC(tick) ((tick) * USEC_PER_TICK)
143: ```
144: 
145: `1000L` 在 32 位 ARM 上仍为 32 位，因此乘法在转换为 `uint64_t` 之前已经溢出。
146: 编译产物也显示只有低 32 位 `mla`，返回值高 32 位被置零。AP 时间会在：
147: 
148: ```text
149: 2^32 us = 4,294,967.296 ms AP time
150: ```
151: 
152: 提前跳回零，而不是在正常的 32 位 tick 边界回卷。跨界前创建的两秒 sleep deadline
153: 大于这个人为最大值，回卷后的时钟永远到不了 deadline，heartbeat 线程永久阻塞。
154: 
155: CP 的 heartbeat fallback timeout 为 6000 ms。实板多次日志均满足：
156: 
157: ```text
158: current - last_heartbeat = 6000 ms
159: Assert at: mb_ipc_task:298
160: ```
161: 
162: 所以重启是 CP 在 AP heartbeat 停止后执行的确定性断言，不是随机复位。
163: 
164: 必需修复：
165: 
166: ```text
167: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
168: ```
169: 
170: 不能只把 heartbeat 改成 busy wait、分段 sleep 或增大 CP timeout。这些只能隐藏一个
171: 调用者，Mailbox worker、semaphore timeout 和其他 watchdog deadline 仍会失效。

183: ```text

185: bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT, PM_CPU_FRQ_60M)

189: 1 ms SysTick 实际约为 2 ms，2 秒 heartbeat 实际约为 4 秒。

193: ```text

195: ```

238:   -> 获取OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold并确认domain ON
239:   -> power CPU1 domain ON
240:   -> 按34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical规则计算CPU1 boot offset
241:   -> 用已验证的语义化helper release CPU1 reset
242:   -> CPU1 OpenVela 按 480 MHz 初始化 SysTick
243:   -> nx_start()内部调用nx_smp_start()/up_cpu_start(1)
244:   -> CPU1 设置 CPU2 secondary vector并用语义化helper release reset
245:   -> CPU2 online和双向IPI自检
246:   -> 发送IPC power-up并启动heartbeat
247:   -> 发送PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD解除CP启动等待
248:   -> 请求并验证PSRAM PWC
249:   -> 成功后发布独立的最终AP/PSRAM-ready门禁
250: ```
251: 
252: `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` 必须先于PSRAM请求：当前CP从low-power worker启动CPU1并在同一
253: worker中等待boot-ready，PSRAM vote也由该worker处理；反向排序会造成双方互等。这里的
254: 最终ready是给上层allocator/driver的独立门禁，不能替换或延后现有boot-ready。
255: 
256: CP 侧建议增加显式配置 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M`，只在外部 OpenVela AP 构建中启用，
257: 避免改变原厂 FreeRTOS AP 的默认行为。该配置下修改：

331: ### 4.3 运行期频率规则
332: 
333: 首版运行期规则只有一条：AP online 时 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 始终 vote 480 MHz。
334: 
335: - CP 默认60 MHz vote可以保留；PM取所有module slot的最大值，AP生命周期内唯一的480M
336:   slot会把共享时钟保持在480 MHz。
337: - AP 不发送 `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` 降频。
338: - 其他 CP/AP module 可以投票，但不能把最大值降到 480 MHz以下。
339: - CP 应提供诊断查询，至少输出 current max vote、全部vote owner、core source、core/bus
340:   divider、CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 speed、VDDD/VDDDIG、CPU1/CPU2 power/reset和PSRAM owner状态。
341: - `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 被 `CONFIG_CLK_FORCE_MAX_CPU_FREQ_320M` 截断时必须判为启动失败，
342:   不能继续用 480 MHz SysTick配置运行。
343: 
344: 保留 `PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD` 命令值 `0xc`，同步扩展AP/CP的
345: `pm_ap_get_cp_data_type_e`，增加只读current-frequency与divider查询类型。扩展必须同时
346: 更新双方header和source override，不能单边复用已有enum数值。
347: 
348: ### 4.4 关闭与故障回滚
349: 
350: 正常关闭或 AP recovery 的顺序必须是：
351: 
352: ```text
353: AP primary停止新任务和外设提交
354:   -> quiesce PSRAM/DMA/Mailbox UART
355:   -> 调度CPU2执行stop callback
356:   -> 屏蔽CPU2普通IRQ和IPI
357:   -> CPU2进入确认的park/WFI状态
358:   -> CPU1用语义化helper将CPU2置reset并确认不再执行
359:   -> AP释放自己的PSRAM PWC owner并等待CP ACK
360:   -> AP向CP回复recovery-ready
361:   -> CP确认CPU2 reset，释放power-only hold并确认CPU2 domain OFF
362:   -> CP停止/reset CPU1并确认CPU1 domain OFF
363:   -> CP以PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT释放PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 slot
364:   -> CP按CPU档位和剩余PSRAM owner重新计算VDDDIG
365: ```
366: 
367: 当前 CP shutdown 代码仅在特定低压配置下才停止 CPU2，而且顺序是先停止 CPU1、后停止
368: CPU2。OpenVela SMP 模式必须改成上述顺序。CPU2仍在执行共享NuttX状态时，CP不能
369: 直接关闭CPU2 power；CPU1已停止后也不能再依赖CPU1去park CPU2。
370: 
371: 所有失败必须达到相同后置条件，但不能强制走同一callback路径：CPU1/CPU2不执行、只对
372: 本事务已获取的CPU2/CPU1 domain、OpenVela PSRAM owner和480M slot按反序释放。
373: 
374: - 480M/readback失败发生在CPU1 release前：CP直接撤销已获取资源，不等待AP。
375: - CPU1 boot超时：CP强制CPU1/CPU2 reset并关闭domain，不等待AP recovery。
376: - CPU2 online超时：CPU1若仍可信就强制CPU2 reset，不能依赖未online的stop callback。
377: - 只有正常recovery才使用完整AP quiesce、park和ready握手。
378: 
379: ## 5. 睡眠与低功耗分阶段方案
380: 
381: ### 5.1 阶段 P0：普通 WFI，禁止 coordinated low-voltage
382: 
383: 首次 SMP 和 480 MHz 验收只启用 per-core 普通 WFI：
384: 
385: - 增加BK7258 `up_idle()`；当前公共ARM `up_idle()`中的WFI被 `#if 0` 禁用，不能把
386:   “空闲任务在运行”误判为已经WFI。chip hook必须清 `SCB_SCR_SLEEPDEEP`，执行
387:   `DSB; WFI; ISB`，且不设置coordinated low-voltage ready bit。
388: - CP在每次OpenVela启动和recovery时显式调用
389:   `bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0)` 并检查 `BK_OK`。
390:   state 0表示AP active/not-ready，因此全芯片low-voltage条件不成立。
391: - 保持 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 关闭。
392: - 不支持 CPU1/CPU2 power-down、retention、CPU2 hotplug 或 tickless。
393: - heartbeat、Mailbox 和 SysTick 在普通 WFI 下仍可唤醒 CPU1。
394: 
395: CP 的 `PM_ENTER_LOW_VOL_MODULES_CONFIG` 包含 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`。启动 OpenVela
396: AP 时应显式写exit-sleep，不能依赖BSS初值；PM初始化实际上会把CPU1置为enter-sleep，
397: 而当前清除代码又受已关闭的 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 条件控制。OpenVela必须
398: 独立执行上述调用，保证未实现低压协议时CP只能进入normal sleep。
399: 
400: ### 5.2 阶段 P1：双核 coordinated low-voltage
401: 
402: 只有 P0 的 24 小时稳定性通过后，才能实现原厂 AP 的等价低压协议。原厂事实为：
403: 
404: - CP 要求 CPU1 和 CPU2 都进入 WFI，并检查 AON PMU 的
405:   `cp1_enter_wfi_state`、`cp2_enter_wfi_state`。
406: - AP 两个核分别屏蔽普通 IRQ，只保留本核 Mailbox wakeup。
407: - CP 保存并切换核心/Flash 时钟，恢复 DPLL 后再唤醒 AP。
408: - 原 AP 依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle 和 `vPortYieldCore()`；这些调用不能直接移植到 NuttX。
409: 
410: NuttX实现必须复用现有SMP PM框架，而不是另建平行barrier：
411: 
412: 1. 启用 `CONFIG_PM=y`、选定governor、`CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3` 和
413:    `CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0`；这里的0是NuttX logical CPU0/物理CPU1，不是CP。
414: 2. BK7258 `up_idle()` 调用 `pm_idle(handler)`；驱动通过 `pm_register()` 注册
415:    `struct pm_callback_s` prepare/notify callback。
416: 3. logical CPU0作为last CPU发起全局transition，禁止新任务迁移、DMA和mailbox
417:    transaction；两核运行per-CPU prepare并保存本核NVIC/SysTick状态。
418: 4. CPU2设置 `cp2_enter_wfi_state` 后进入WFI；CPU1确认CPU2已就绪。
419: 5. CPU1停止SysTick，设置 `cp1_enter_wfi_state`，通过既有sleep vote允许CP进入低压。
420: 6. CP只在两个AON WFI bit、AP sleep/clock vote和mailbox idle都满足后切换低压。
421: 7. CP恢复DPLL、经readback验证的480 MHz档位和bus后，通过Mailbox唤醒AP。
422: 8. CPU1读取AON elapsed time，恢复monotonic time和SysTick；再唤醒CPU2。
423: 9. 两核恢复NVIC和驱动callback，`pm_idle()`完成restore并恢复heartbeat。
424: 
425: 低压时间基准不能继续完全依赖core-clock SysTick。增加BK7258 strong
426: `up_timer_gettick()`/`up_timer_gettime()`，以AON RTC构建64位单调epoch；当前原厂启用
427: 64-bit AON counter，应使用稳定的low/high重读算法，不需要软件扩展32-bit wrap。必须由
428: CP契约确认32 kHz源是32000还是32768 Hz，并用64位算术换算、校准和验证回卷单调性。
429: 
430: 时间读取本身不是唤醒源。P1必须提供下一NuttX deadline的AON/CP wake：推荐启用
431: `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS=y`，实现完整的 `up_timer_tick_cancel()`/
432: `up_timer_tick_start()` 或 `up_alarm_cancel()`/`up_alarm_start()` AON compare backend。
433: 若暂时保持periodic语义，则必须编程AON wake不晚于下一1 ms tick，收益有限。恢复时先
434: 确认clock稳定，再重启SysTick；解除PM barrier前必须让logical CPU0至少执行一次timer
435: processing，使低压期间到期的sleep和watchdog立即得到处理。
436: 
437: 在 AON-backed monotonic time、双核 barrier和驱动 PM callback完成前，禁止打开 P1。
438: 
439: ### 5.3 Deep sleep
440: 
441: Deep sleep定义为 AP 上下文丢失后的完整重启，不是 NuttX suspend-to-RAM：
442: 
443: - CPU1/CPU2、NuttX heap、scheduler、Mailbox transport和PSRAM对象均视为丢失。
444: - CP/bootloader重新启动 CPU1，CPU1重新启动 CPU2。
445: - PSRAM generation必须变化，旧对象不可复用。
446: - 不承诺从原 PC/任务现场继续运行。
447:

532: ### 6.3 CPU ID
533: 
534: 原厂 AP 使用每核私有 DTCM地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP逻辑核 ID。OpenVela采用：
535: 
536: ```text
537: 物理CPU1私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU0
538: 物理CPU2私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU1
539: ```
540: 
541: `up_cpu_index()` 直接读取该word。primary在任何 per-CPU/NuttX atomic调用前写0；
542: secondary在任何NuttX API前写1。必须实板验证两核看到的是私有实例，不是共享word。
543: 
544: ### 6.4 内存、secondary vector和栈
545: 
546: 分区保持：
547: 
548: ```text
549: AP_SPINLOCK  0x28000000..0x2800ffff
550: AP_RAM       0x28010000..0x28063fff
551: CP_RAM       0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
552: PWR_MNG      0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
553: SWAP         0x2809f800..0x2809ffff
554: ```
555: 
556: CPU2不增加Flash/RAM分区。链接脚本增加：
557: 
558: - `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，绝不加入heap。
559: - 512字节对齐的 `.bk_secondary_vectors`。
560: - 只用于reset早期的CPU2 bootstrap stack。
561: - 两份静态 interrupt stack，或等价的每核固定中断栈区域。
562: - 全部边界和对齐 `ASSERT`。
563: 
564: secondary vector：
565: 
566: ```text
567: word 0: CPU2 bootstrap MSP top
568: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
569: ```
570: 
571: CPU2 boot offset寄存器只保存地址高24位，至少要求256字节对齐；统一采用512字节以
572: 满足VTOR约束。secondary vector不包含primary image offset `0x100` 的BK legacy magic。
573: 
574: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 应像RP2040一样调用 `up_create_stack()`，初始化logical CPU1 idle
575: TCB。还必须分配 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE` 对齐空间并实现
576: `uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)`；公共ARM实现只覆盖UP构建，ARMv8-M任务初始状态
577: 会调用该hook。CPU2 reset后先用bootstrap MSP；进入NuttX前将PSP切到idle TCB stack
578: top，调用 `arm_initialize_stack()` 安装本核MSP/MSPLIM interrupt stack。两个核不得共用
579: MSP。
580: 
581: ### 6.5 CPU2启动
582: 
583: `up_cpu_start(1)`：
584: 
585: ```text
586: 校验cpu==1且当前为logical CPU0
587:   -> 确认CP的OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold和domain readback均为ON
588:   -> 确认480 MHz契约和channel 2已配置
589:   -> 发布idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
590:   -> 清boot stage/online flag，DMB/DSB
591:   -> CPU2保持reset时清route/pending
592:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL=1
593:   -> CPU2_OFFSET=secondary_vector>>8
594:   -> cpu2_release_reset()（极性已由run-status/实板验证）
595:   -> 有界等待online和双向IPI自检
596: ```
597: 
598: 超时建议500 ms，输出CPU2 control、run status、route、NVIC、Mailbox channel 2、boot
599: stage和当前频率readback，然后panic。不能只返回错误后继续 `nx_bringup()`。
600: 
601: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 只初始化每核私有状态：
602: 
603: - logical ID、FPU CP10/11和barrier。
604: - 与primary一致的SAU/MPU/VTOR。
605: - CPU2私有NVIC enable/pending/priority。
606: - CPU2 Mailbox route和IRQ79。
607: - PSP/MSP/stack limit。
608: - release-ordered online flag、可选的 `sched_note_cpu_started(this_task())`、
609:   `nx_idle_trampoline()`。
610: 
611: primary以acquire语义等待online flag。`sched_note_cpu_started()`只是可选trace，在note
612: driver未启用时为空，不能承担online handshake。
613: 
614: secondary禁止复制 `.data`、清 `.bss`、初始化heap/PSRAM/driver、调用 `nx_start()`、
615: 初始化第二个SysTick或重置全局Mailbox FIFO。
616: 
617: ### 6.6 每核MPU/NVIC
618: 
619: MPU、SAU、NVIC、VTOR、SysTick和FPU控制均为每核私有。CPU2必须安装与CPU1相同的：
620: 
621: - AP Flash RO/X。
622: - AP RAM RW/XN/shareable。
623: - `AP_SPINLOCK` RW/XN/non-cacheable/shareable。
624: - CP共享窗口和Mailbox UART override。
625: - PSRAM 16 MiB RW/XN/non-cacheable。
626: - peripheral Device/XN。
627: 
628: 当前 CPU1 使用7个 MPU region；增加 AP_SPINLOCK 后至少需要8个，启动时继续读
629: `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`并 fail-stop。CPU2不能重复probe或初始化PSRAM allocator。
630: 
631: 全局NuttX IRQ table只由primary初始化一次。CPU2只初始化私有NVIC和CPU2 route：
632: 
633: ```text
634: CPU1 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010088 / 0x4401008c
635: CPU2 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010090 / 0x44010094
636: ```
637: 
638: 首版只有CPU2 Mailbox IPI路由到CPU2。GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、Wi-Fi和其他
639: 有状态外设仍由logical CPU0 owner。
640: 
641: ## 7. Mailbox IPI与CP transport共存
642: 
643: ### 7.1 物理channel
644: 
645: | channel | owner | FIFO |
646: | ---: | --- | --- |
647: | 0 | CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
648: | 1 | CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
649: | 2 | CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
650: 
651: 沿用原厂消息分类：
652: 
653: ```text
654: data[1] != 0: pointer + length envelope，进入CP/AP logical transport
655: data[1] == 0: AP内部raw command，进入SMP IPI handler
656: ```
657: 
658: CPU2不处理CP PWC、heartbeat、Wi-Fi或Mailbox UART envelope。CP transport始终由
659: logical CPU0负责。
660: 
661: ### 7.2 当前初始化路径的改造
662: 
663: 当前 physical Mailbox 已在 `arm_serialinit()` 中经：
664: 
665: ```text
666: bk7258_mailbox_init()
667: bk7258_mb_uart_init()
668: bk7258_mailbox_start()
669: ```
670: 
671: 启动。这发生在 `nx_smp_start()` 之前，生命周期适合SMP。改造要求：
672: 
673: 1. primary physical start一次性配置channel 1和2 FIFO，不能在CPU2 online后soft reset。
674: 2. 全局 `irq_attach(79, ...)` 只执行一次；CPU2复用共享NuttX IRQ handler table，但启用
675:    自己的route和私有NVIC line 63。
676: 3. ISR按 `up_cpu_index()` 选择本核physical channel。
677: 4. channel 1可处理CP envelope和raw IPI；channel 2只接受raw IPI。
678: 5. shared transport状态从仅 `up_irq_save()` 改为SMP spinlock，或严格固定到CPU0。
679: 
680: ### 7.3 NuttX SMP hooks
681: 
682: 实现：
683: 
684: ```c
685: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
686: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
687: ```
688: 
689: raw command采用pending bitmap合并 `SCHED`、`CALL`和 `PM`。发送前DMB，ISR读取并清
690: pending后DMB，然后调用：
691: 
692: ```c
693: nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg);
694: nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu());
695: ```
696: 
697: FIFO full不能静默丢失。采用“shared pending bit + kick”语义：消息只负责唤醒，真实
698: 工作由pending bit保持；如果目标已有未处理kick，不重复占FIFO。发送失败需要有界重试、
699: 计数和fatal门限，禁止持有目标ISR需要的spinlock时无限等待。
700: 
701: ## 8. Atomic、spinlock和共享驱动
702: 
703: ### 8.1 BK7258约束
704: 
705: 原厂注释明确：BK7258 AP SMP只有两个exclusive monitor；两个CPU同时对普通SRAM做
706: exclusive访问时，第三方DMA/Audio写SRAM可能无提示失败。因此原厂把所有spinlock对象
707: 集中在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 特殊SRAM区。
708: 
709: `AP_SPINLOCK`不是寄存器型硬件spinlock。首版使用一个位于该区的software gate，
710: 通过LDAXR/STXR仲裁NuttX `atomic_*` 和libc out-of-line atomic helper：
711: 
712: ```text
713: CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK=y
714: g_atomic_hwspinlock -> struct hwspinlock_dev_s -> BK7258 software gate
715: ```
716: 
717: gate owner使用 `logical_cpu + 1`，0表示free，避免CPU0 owner和free混淆。trylock使用
718: acquire exclusive，unlock使用release store、DSB和SEV。primary在进入 `nx_start()` 前
719: 初始化gate；CPU2启动后禁止再次清零。
720: 
721: 这不会自动拦截编译器内联 `__atomic_*`、`__sync_*` 或手写exclusive loop。SMP源码禁止
722: 直接使用这些路径，构建时反汇编全部SMP对象，除approved gate外发现LDREX/STREX或
723: LDAXR/STXR循环即失败。只有DMA/Audio/exclusive压力通过后才能评估更细粒度方案。
724: 
725: ### 8.2 驱动收敛
726: 
727: 首版将以下worker和IRQ固定到logical CPU0：
728: 
729: - Mailbox transport/UART/syslog/PWC/heartbeat。
730: - Wi-Fi、camera、QSPI、DMA和媒体worker。
731: - GPIO、button/motor、PWM、I2C。
732: - 所有未完成SMP审计的board driver。
733: 
734: worker入口在访问任何driver状态前先构造 `CPU_ZERO/CPU_SET(0)` mask，并调用
735: `sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpu_set_t), &cpuset)`；成功后才通知creator ready。creator
736: 等待该ready，affinity失败则driver bring-up失败。不能在 `kthread_create()` 返回后才pin，
737: 因为worker可能已经运行。
738: 
739: 即使worker固定CPU0，CPU2任务仍可能调用公共API。以下共享状态必须使用
740: `spin_lock_irqsave()` 或mutex：
741: 
742: - Mailbox active transaction、ACK pool、recovery epoch和ring index。
743: - syslog/serial TX/RX ring。
744: - GPIO/PWM/I2C寄存器RMW。
745: - PSRAM allocator状态、allocation counters和generation。
746: - Wi-Fi command/data slot和pbuf ownership。
747: 
748: ISR共享短状态使用spinlock；会等待ACK、semaphore、内存或格式化日志的路径使用mutex，
749: 禁止在spinlock内sleep。
750: 
751: ## 9. 系统tick、heartbeat与时间正确性
752: 
753: 首版只有logical CPU0启动SysTick。CPU2不得调用 `up_timer_initialize()`，否则系统时间
754: 和RR accounting加倍。CPU0每tick调用NuttX timer处理，调度器通过IPI要求CPU2切换。
755: 
756: 必须满足：
757: 
758: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`。
759: - CPU1实际频率和 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000` 一致。
760: - 60秒wall clock测试误差在晶振/调度允许范围内，不能出现2倍或1/2倍。
761: - heartbeat实际周期约2秒，不是4秒。
762: - heartbeat发送返回值必须检查并统计 `-EBUSY`、`-ENOLINK`、timeout。
763: - CP heartbeat使用实际 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 配置；timeout至少容纳调度抖动和一次transport
764:   recovery，但不能用增大timeout掩盖lost heartbeat。
765: 
766: 长期测试必须跨越旧故障边界：至少运行3小时；正式验收运行24小时。还应通过调试构建
767: 把timer timebase置于旧的 `UINT32_MAX / 1000` 边界前，快速验证sleep跨界。
768:

787: divider readback和外部测量确认为240 MHz，无320M clamp；PSRAM ON/OFF故障注入不会发布

816: 2. 实现pending-bit raw IPI、`up_send_smp_sched/call`。
817: 3. 完成双向call、task migration、semaphore/mutex和atomic压力。

824: 2. 审计Mailbox、syslog、GPIO/PWM/I2C、PSRAM、Wi-Fi和camera共享状态。

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 AP_SPINLOCK-backed software hwspinlock.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <assert.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: 
11: #include <nuttx/hwspinlock/hwspinlock.h>
12: 
13: #include "arm_internal.h"
14: 
15: struct bk7258_atomic_gate_s
16: {
17:   volatile uint32_t interested[2];
18:   volatile uint32_t turn;
19:   volatile uint32_t owner;
20: };
21: 
22: static struct bk7258_atomic_gate_s g_bk7258_atomic_gate
23:   __attribute__((section(".bk_spinlock"), aligned(32)));
24: 
25: static bool bk7258_hwspinlock_trylock(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
26: {
27:   unsigned int cpu = (unsigned int)up_cpu_index();
28:   unsigned int other = cpu ^ 1u;
29: 
30:   (void)dev;
31:   DEBUGASSERT(cpu < 2);
32: 
33:   /* BK7258 has only two SRAM exclusive monitors while CP, AP CPU1 and AP
34:    * CPU2 are all active.  Keep the AP-only atomic gate independent of
35:    * LDAEX/STREX so CP traffic cannot starve an AP exclusive sequence.
36:    */
37: 
38:   if (g_bk7258_atomic_gate.interested[cpu] == 0)
39:     {
40:       g_bk7258_atomic_gate.interested[cpu] = 1;
41:       UP_DMB();
42:       g_bk7258_atomic_gate.turn = other;
43:     }
44: 
45:   UP_DMB();
46:   if (g_bk7258_atomic_gate.interested[other] != 0 &&
47:       g_bk7258_atomic_gate.turn == other)
48:     {
49:       return false;
50:     }
51: 
52:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate.owner = cpu + 1u;
53:   UP_DMB();
54:   return true;
55: }
56: 
57: static void bk7258_hwspinlock_relax(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
58: {
59:   (void)dev;
60:   __asm__ volatile("nop" ::: "memory");
61: }
62: 
63: static void bk7258_hwspinlock_unlock(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
64: {
65:   unsigned int cpu = (unsigned int)up_cpu_index();
66: 
67:   (void)dev;
68:   if (cpu >= 2 || g_bk7258_atomic_gate.owner != cpu + 1u)
69:     {
70:       PANIC();
71:     }
72: 
73:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate.owner = 0;
74:   UP_DMB();
75:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate.interested[cpu] = 0;
76:   UP_DSB();
77:   __asm__ volatile("sev" ::: "memory");
78: }
79: 
80: const struct hwspinlock_ops_s g_bk7258_hwspinlock_ops =
81: {
82:   .trylock = bk7258_hwspinlock_trylock,
83:   .relax   = bk7258_hwspinlock_relax,
84:   .unlock  = bk7258_hwspinlock_unlock
85: };
86: 
87: void bk7258_hwspinlock_initialize(void)
88: {
89:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate.interested[0] = 0;
90:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate.interested[1] = 0;
91:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate.turn = 0;
92:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate.owner = 0;
93:   UP_DSB();
94:   __asm__ volatile("sev" ::: "memory");
95: }

23: #define BK7258_IPI_CALL         (1u << 1)
24: #define BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT  1024
25: 
26: #define BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_NOTIFY (BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK + 1u)

37: static int bk7258_smp_boot_send(int cpu, uint32_t command)

42:   UP_DMB();
43:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)
44:     {
45:       int ret = bk7258_mbox_send((uint8_t)(cpu + 1), data);
46: 
47:       if (ret == OK)
48:         {
49:           return OK;
50:         }
51: 
52:       if (ret != -EAGAIN)
53:         {
54:           return ret;
55:         }
56: 
57:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
58:     }
59: 
60:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
61: }

63: static int bk7258_smp_kick(int cpu, uint32_t pending)
64: {
65:   uint32_t data[2] = {BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK, 0};
66:   int expected = 0;
67:   int retry;
68: 
69:   if ((unsigned int)cpu >= CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS || cpu == this_cpu())
70:     {
71:       return -EINVAL;
72:     }
73: 
74:   atomic_or_release(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], pending);
75:   if (!atomic_cmpxchg_acquire(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], &expected, 1))
76:     {
77:       return OK;
78:     }
79: 
80:   UP_DMB();
81:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)
82:     {
83:       int ret = bk7258_mbox_send((uint8_t)(cpu + 1), data);
84: 
85:       if (ret == OK)
86:         {

88:         }
89: 
90:       if (ret != -EAGAIN)
91:         {
92:           return ret;
93:         }
94: 
95:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
96:     }
97: 
98:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
99: }

102: {
103:   int cpu = this_cpu();
104: 
105:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_NOTIFY)
106:     {
107:       if (cpu == 0)
108:         {
109:           g_boot_seen |= BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_NOTIFY;
110:         }
111: 
112:       return;
113:     }
114: 
115:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_PING)
116:     {
117:       if (cpu == 1 &&
118:           bk7258_smp_boot_send(0, BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_ACK) < 0)
119:         {
120:           PANIC();
121:         }
122: 
123:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK);
124:       return;
125:     }
126: 
127:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_ACK)
128:     {
129:       if (cpu == 0)
130:         {
131:           g_boot_seen |= BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_ACK;
132:         }
133: 
134:       return;
135:     }
136: 
137:   if (command != BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
138:     {
139:       return;
140:     }
141: 
142:   for (;;)
143:     {
144:       uint32_t pending = atomic_xchg_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
145: 
146:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_CALL) != 0)
147:         {
148:           nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, NULL);
149:         }
150: 
151:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_SCHED) != 0)
152:         {
153:           nxsched_process_delivered(cpu);
154:         }
155: 
156:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
157:       UP_DMB();
158:       if (atomic_read_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu]) == 0)
159:         {
160:           break;
161:         }
162: 
163:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 1);
164:     }
165: }

171:   if (ret < 0)

173:       PANIC();

176:   return ret;

182:

182:  *   the case that any logic on the same CPU attempts to take the lock
183:  *   more than once.

199: {

201:

203:

205: 
206:   sched_note_spinlock(lock, NOTE_SPINLOCK_LOCK);

52: /****************************************************************************
53:  * Name:  nxsched_cpu_scheduler
54:  *
55:  * Description:
56:  *   Check for operations specific to scheduling policy of the currently
57:  *   active task on one CPU.
58:  *
59:  * Input Parameters:
60:  *   cpu - The CPU that we are performing the scheduler operations on.
61:  *
62:  * Returned Value:
63:  *   None
64:  *
65:  ****************************************************************************/
66: 
67: #if CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL > 0 || defined(CONFIG_SCHED_SPORADIC)
68: static inline void nxsched_cpu_scheduler(int cpu)
69: {
70:   FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb = current_task(cpu);
71: 
72: #if CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL > 0
73:   /* Check if the currently executing task uses round robin scheduling. */
74: 
75:   if ((atomic_read(&rtcb->flags) & TCB_FLAG_POLICY_MASK) ==
76:       TCB_FLAG_SCHED_RR)
77:     {
78:       /* Yes, check if the currently executing task has exceeded its
79:        * timeslice.
80:        */
81: 
82:       nxsched_process_roundrobin(rtcb, 1, false);
83:     }
84: #endif
85: 
86: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_SPORADIC
87:   /* Check if the currently executing task uses sporadic scheduling. */
88: 
89:   if ((atomic_read(&rtcb->flags) & TCB_FLAG_POLICY_MASK) ==
90:       TCB_FLAG_SCHED_SPORADIC)
91:     {
92:       /* Yes, check if the currently executing task has exceeded its
93:        * budget.
94:        */
95: 
96:       nxsched_process_sporadic(rtcb, 1, false);
97:     }
98: #endif
99: }
100: #endif
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name:  nxsched_process_scheduler
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Check for operations specific to scheduling policy of the currently
107:  *   active task on all configured CPUs.
108:  *
109:  * Input Parameters:
110:  *   None
111:  *
112:  * Returned Value:
113:  *   None
114:  *
115:  ****************************************************************************/
116: 
117: #if CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL > 0 || defined(CONFIG_SCHED_SPORADIC)
118: static inline void nxsched_process_scheduler(void)
119: {
120:   irqstate_t flags;
121:   int i;
122: 
123:   /* Single CPU case:
124:    * For nested interrupts, higher IRQs may interrupt nxsched_cpu_scheduler()
125:    * but nxsched_cpu_scheduler() requires that interrupts be disabled.
126:    * We are in ISR context, no meaning we are disabled the interrupts.
127:    *
128:    * SMP case:
129:    * enter_critical_section() does much more than just disable interrupts on
130:    * the local CPU; it also manages spinlocks to assure the stability of the
131:    * TCB that we are manipulating.
132:    */
133: 
134:   flags = enter_critical_section();
135: 
136:   /* Perform scheduler operations on all CPUs */
137: 
138:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; i++)
139:     {
140:       nxsched_cpu_scheduler(i);
141:     }
142: 
143:   leave_critical_section(flags);
144: }
145: #else
146: #  define nxsched_process_scheduler()
147: #endif

163:  *
164:  * Description:
165:  *   This function handles system timer events.
166:  *   The timer interrupt logic itself is implemented in the
167:  *   architecture specific code, but must call the following OS
168:  *   function periodically -- the calling interval must be
169:  *   USEC_PER_TICK
170:  *
171:  * Input Parameters:
172:  *   None
173:  *
174:  * Returned Value:
175:  *   None
176:  *
177:  ****************************************************************************/

179: void nxsched_process_timer(void)
